sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.

findings.why: No approved supplier list or controlled record covers SUP-B for BR-180 (any receiving plant or customer). The only SUP-B approval in the documents is for BR-220. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether an approval exists. The BR-180 customer and receiving plant are also not stated.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material.

findings.why: Adding SUP-B as a second source for BR-180 is a change of source. No EN 10204 3.1 certificate from SUP-B for the BR-180 drawing material is in the documents. The supplier quality engineer needs to obtain or confirm it.
